cands.name: Juan Porras
cands.bio: Republican, Florida House District 119 since November 2022, succeeding Juan Fernandez-Barquin. Former staffer to Sen. Marco Rubio, Gov. Rick Scott and Reps. Fernandez-Barquin and Spencer Roach. FIU political science graduate.
cands.local_ties: Born in Miami in 1997 to Cuban immigrant parents; Wikipedia's district page calls him a Republican from West Kendall.

record.text: District 119 is 51.0% Democratic and 47.6% Republican by registration (Wikipedia district page).
